title: MultiAccountTransactionsDownloadRequest
description: Serializer for multi-account transaction export requests.

account_uuids.description: List of account UUIDs to include in the export.

min_date.description: Start date of the export range (inclusive).

max_date.description: End date of the export range (inclusive, end of day).

bai_codes.description: List of 3-digit BAI transaction type codes to filter by. If omitted, all transaction types are included.

format.description:
Export file format. Defaults to CSV.

* `csv` - CSV
* `bai2` - BAI2

filename.description: Custom filename for the downloaded file. Must end with the correct extension (.csv or .bai2).
